conditions: Five alternating process pairs on internal APFS. Each process creates, indexes, compacts and reopens a fresh 20,000-row fixture, warms five handler paths, then rotates 50 requests per shape. Exact row counts and all JSON fields checked after timing. Identical benchmark installed in baseline archive; archive mtimes refreshed and fresh artifacts/distinct executable hashes verified. No concurrent builds/tests, caches not forcibly evicted, other applications not stopped. Peak RSS includes fixture/response buffers. Direct REST handler calls include admission, SQL, response serialization and guard drop, but exclude transport/live peers. Shapes include native count/full projection, DataFusion aggregate, a 10,000-literal IN list and a 126-term addition chain; all produce identical exact values on both revisions. Separate subprocess tests cover previously aborting SQL, text/syntax/parser boundaries and seeded valid/incomplete expressions. Protocol tests verify explicit rejection, storage immutability and subsequent REST/gRPC query recovery. Production ingestion, storage format, dependencies and toolchain are unchanged. No production, external-volume or service access.
